name: Soya Bean Chutney (Axone Chutney)
ingredients: Fresh red chillies (or Raja Mircha/Bhut Jolokia for heat)
Spring onion or coriander leaves for garnish
instructions: 1. Roast the fermented Axone beans lightly over an open flame or in a dry pan until fragrant.
2. In a mortar and pestle, crush the garlic, ginger, and fresh chillies into a coarse paste.
3. Add the roasted Axone to the mortar and continue pounding until the beans are semi-mashed but still retain some texture.
4. If using tomatoes, roast them separately, peel, and mix into the paste.
5. Season with salt and garnish with chopped spring onions before serving.
description: Axone, also known as 'Akhuni', is a staple fermented soya bean product central to Naga cuisine. Known for its strong, pungent aroma and deep umami flavor, this chutney is an essential side dish served with steamed rice and boiled vegetables in Naga households.
